The Trump Admin & Congressional GOP tried to dismantle & sabotage the Affordable Care Act.

Last year, @POTUS & Congressional Democrats boosted the ACA when we passed the #AmericanRescuePlan. Now a record number of people have quality, affordable coverage.
https://t.co/2wxq36MyGb

A record-breaking 14.5M people signed up for coverage under the Affordable Care Act. Instead of sabotaging the ACA like the GOP did in the Trump years, @POTUS & Democrats in Congress passed the #AmericanRescuePlan to make health care more affordable.
https://t.co/7dAVTIaYwb

Over the past decade, Democrats have helped millions of Americans get high-quality health care by expanding access to affordable coverage. Despite the progress we’ve made in lowering costs & expanding access, many Americans are still struggling to afford the care they need.

School lunch waivers provided an additional 10M students free school meals each day during the pandemic. The last thing we should do is prematurely revoke these benefits and deprive students of the nutrition they need to help them learn and grow.
https://t.co/PuxTIBZeg3

Exactly 12 years ago, President Obama signed the Affordable Care Act into law, protecting millions of Americans with pre-existing conditions and expanding access to medical coverage.

Today, the ACA continues to fulfill the promise that health care is a right, not a privilege. https://t.co/k4sPZ3kMIm

This is good news for millions of families that haven't been able to get the tax credits they need to purchase affordable health coverage. By improving the ACA, the Administration is continuing to stand up for Americans and expand access to affordable health care. #ProtectOurCare

Child hunger, diet-related illness, and inadequate access to care persist in many of our communities, particularly as we recover from the pandemic.

I applaud @POTUS for launching this initiative to ensure all Americans have the nutrition & care needed to live fulfilling lives.

The #KeepKidsFed Act provides additional assistance to ensure that students can get the nutrition they need to help them learn and grow. While this bill does not go as far as I would like in supporting our nation’s students, it is a meaningful step.

Over the past two years, we have delivered historic relief to help address food insecurity spurred by the pandemic. 
 
It's clear: when we invest in child nutrition programs, child hunger rates go down. 
 
https://t.co/sH3tdRpQ3A

📚Read our statement here ⤵️

https://t.co/SsVZ49IPbZ

The Healthy Meals, Healthy Kids Act that I introduced with @RepBonamici will modernize proven child nutrition programs, provide more children & families with access to nutrition assistance and help fulfill our basic responsibility to keep children from going hungry.

Baseball is a great outlet for young people. I gave remarks at  @NNMayorPriceDDS’ 6th Annual Play Ball event to encourage boys and girls to learn about the game, get some exercise and have an evening of fun https://t.co/gay2kZYkMm

Earlier tonight I tested positive for COVID-19 after experiencing very mild COVID-like symptoms. Per CDC guidelines, I will self-isolate and will follow the directives of my doctor. I am grateful to be fully-vaccinated and double boosted.

Today, I’m proud to stand by my colleagues for #CongressGoesPurple to celebrate Recovery Month. If you, or a loved one, are struggling with a mental health or substance use disorder, remember that recovery is possible. Learn more here: https://t.co/SHWKDINfno

I applaud @POTUS for organizing the first @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, & Health in more than a half a century.

This is an important opportunity to develop a national strategy to end hunger & reaffirm our commitment to achieving a healthier and brighter future.
To read my full statement, click below ⤵️https://t.co/nPKL3fy4md

By opposing our Inflation Reduction Act, Republicans voted against lower prescription drug prices and lower health insurance premiums.

Democrats and @POTUS stood up to Big Pharma and special interests and enacted the law anyway. #PeopleOverPolitics.

Reminder that open enrollment is underway! Head over to https://t.co/aUuUw8GAEe to make sure you are covered for 2023. Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, coverage may be more affordable than ever! https://t.co/iUyvnaVVpu
It was great to see Peninsula residents taking advantage of the Community Health, Wellness, Career and Business Fair today at the Hampton Convention Center https://t.co/1zBoe1FqLM
Great seeing the vendors and attendees at the Community Health, Wellness, Career and Business Fair today at the Hampton Convention Center https://t.co/jiYOziJsSI
Great seeing everyone at today’s National Impact Day of Service and Wellness Expo https://t.co/efmCXHB91e

As the Covid National Emergency period ends, automatic Medicaid renewals are drawing to a close. Events like the Enrollfest I attended today are an important resource for the community, so people can get information to keep coverage https://t.co/5ehGLKDjtx

Affordable, reliable health care coverage is available NOW at https://t.co/cKnlP6hghf. This year, 4 out of 5 Americans can find plans for less than $10 a month!
 
Mark your calendars! You have until January 15, 2024 to enroll in a plan that works for you. https://t.co/PrtciMEjsW

UAW’s triumph in securing these contracts affirms what the labor movement has known for generations— when workers exercise their collective bargaining rights, they can negotiate for higher wages, better benefits, and safer working conditions.

#WorldAIDSDay is a day to reflect on the progress we have made in fighting the HIV/AIDS epidemic. 

We must continue to push for more research, treatment, and resources. https://t.co/Q8jX70zQbN
